_baseline: 5.38 over the corpus (374 screens), measured 2026-10-12 after the walkthrough fixtures joined it; was 5.24 / 305 screens on 2026-10-10, 5.13 on 2026-09-12 and 4.38 / 444 screens on 2026-08-12
_raised_2026_10_12: The exhaustive walkthrough (design/ga-plan/walkthrough-brief.md) added 43 e2e fixtures under e2e/sut/modules/sample1 that are CATALOGUES by design: each exercises its whole area's declarative surface in one screen (ActionsLab every action outcome, LayoutWalkForm every layout annotation, the shell apps one per variant…), averaging 7.4 annotations against 5.18 for the 331 pre-existing screens, which are UNCHANGED. The labels that merely repeated the humanized name (23, the debt the rule is for) were removed first; what is left is the information those fixtures exist to declare.
_raised_2026_10_10: demo-vb-pms imitates OPERA Cloud screens one to one: its annotations are mostly information only the developer has (the guide's screen and step titles, labels that are not the field name). Labels equal to the humanized name were removed, and enum constants are now humanized by all three backends (they used to show raw, which forced a @Label on every constant), so those @Labels went too.
_why_headroom: A ceiling pinned to the exact current value fails on the very next annotation added anywhere, and a check that fires on ordinary work gets raised by reflex until it means nothing. A little headroom means normal work passes and a TREND trips it.
_when_it_fires: Either infer it instead (doc/.../authoring-rule.md), or raise this deliberately and say why in the commit. Raising it is allowed; raising it silently is the thing to avoid.
